meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: Много дел = a lot to do.

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
He is sitting on the sofa.
I will reach the sofa myself.
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: A person's own room at work. From French 'cabinet' (private study or office).

examples.text: Николай Филиппович, я сейчас в кабинете у мэра.
examples.trans: Nikolai Filippovich, I'm in the mayor's office right now.
All right, here you go. There, look.

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?

examples.text: Ну что ты молчишь? Ты толстый, ты не спортсмен!
examples.trans: Well, why are you so quiet? You're fat, you're no athlete!

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Никто не будет командовать на моей кухне!
examples.trans: Nobody is going to give orders in my kitchen!

examples.text: Не говори об этом никому, ладно?
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone about this, okay?
But legally you are nobody to her.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: У меня есть отдельная комната в коммуналке.
examples.trans: I have a separate room in a communal flat.

examples.text: У меня есть две отдельные комнаты.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
Bring him tomorrow to the hospital.
The father brought his son to the doctor.
You will bring the child in the morning.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.
There is a separate restroom for staff.
The apartment has a combined bathroom and toilet.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: Not to be confused with слива (plum), whose genitive plural is also слив.

examples.text: Там слив сломался, а мы его...
examples.trans: The drain broke there, and we...
Yesterday the washing machine broke down.
Why are you mistreating our staff?
All staff members gathered in the conference hall.
The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: Predicative + dative: вам удобно говорить? = is it a good time to talk?

examples.text: Я вижу, тебе у нас не совсем удобно.
examples.trans: I can see you're not quite comfortable at our place.

examples.text: Шеф, а вам удобно сейчас говорить?
examples.trans: Chef, is it a good time to talk?

meanings.en: to participate, to take part (в + prepositional)

examples.trans: I am taking part in the election.

examples.text: Как вы знаете, Виталий, я участвую в выборах.
examples.trans: As you know, Vitaly, I am taking part in the election.

examples.text: Но я в этих махинациях не участвовал!
examples.trans: But I did not participate in these schemes!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: in comparisons: больше, чем = more than

examples.text: А почему нет? Продавец получает больше, чем преподаватель.
examples.trans: Why not? A sales assistant earns more than a lecturer.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Я хочу, чтобы свадьба была в шикарном ресторане!
examples.trans: I want the wedding to be in a swanky restaurant!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
